title: Actress Julia Fox Indicates Drake Might Been Her Best Celebrity Date
htmlContent:
Julia Fox talks about an extravagant date with the well-known rapper Drake.

In an appearance on Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen on Thursday, actress Uncut Gems reminded. The best celebrity date she's ever had when a spectator asked.

"Being on a private jet, cuddled on the jet, landed, got some Chanel bags," Fox, 32, shared. She also added, "It was great, yeah."

Directed by moderator Andy Cohen who he was, Fox played coy. "I can't say. I really can't say," she said , "obviously an A-lister."

Cohen then asked Fox, if she has ever been on a date with the Certified Lover Boy.

"Maybe," Fox replied a couple beats later, visibly reacting with an eye roll before telling the Bravo host with a smirk, "Shouldn't have given me that shot."

It's not the first time Fox's made reference to a Drake.

Last February 2022, she shared a story about her podcast Forbidden Fruits, where she was dating the Her Loss artist.

"He's a great guy and a gentleman... and that was it. Nothing really happened, we were just, like, friends hanging out," Fox said. "I wouldn't say that we were dating."
